picks.reasoning: Everyone's drooling over GEN's win streak, but BLG's stars just beat T1 and DK, and they win lanes by +1.0k at 15 minutes. Talent wins finals, so I'm taking BLG.
BLG's +1.0k GD@15 is the biggest early lead on the board: first drake, first Herald, lanes snowballing before minute 15. They also just beat T1 and DK, so I'm backing the tempo kings.
Fearless Draft punishes one-trick comfort picks, and BLG just took T1 apart 3-1 by out-drafting them across four games, so I trust their depth over GEN's clean sweeps.
GEN edges BLG in series win rate, game win rate (75% vs 71%) and record against other regions (9-1 vs 13-3), but BLG's bigger sample and +1.0k GD@15 keep this close.
BLG dropped their opener to MKOI, then rebuilt and beat DK and T1 in the knockouts; I trust a room that has already bounced back once when the pressure is on.
